title: The Unquiet Autopsy
author: Beatrix Underhill
blurb: Ansel Brightwater, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the trial begins.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
